# Vendored Frontend Libraries

These pinned minified libraries are bundled locally so the dashboard runs fully offline on a local LAN with no external CDN dependency:

- `alpine.min.js`: Alpine.js `3.14.9` (from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.14.9/dist/cdn.min.js`)
- `chart.umd.min.js`: Chart.js `4.4.8` (from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.8/dist/chart.umd.min.js`)
